files.suite.rkt:
#lang racket
;; 一个缩到最小的测试文件，用来问「数得出来的东西」。

(define (linear-search vec x)
  (for/first ([i (in-range (vector-length vec))]
              #:when (equal? (vector-ref vec i) x))
    i))

(define (binary-search vec v)
  (let loop ([lo 0] [hi (vector-length vec)])
    (if (>= lo hi)
        #f
        (let* ([mid (quotient (+ lo hi) 2)]
               [x (vector-ref vec mid)])
          (cond
            [(= x v) mid]
            [(< x v) (loop (add1 mid) hi)]
            [else (loop lo mid)])))))

(module+ test
  (require rackunit)
  (check-equal? (binary-search #(1 2 3) 2) 1)
  (check-equal? (binary-search #(1 2 3) 9) #f)
  (for ([n (in-range 0 40)])
    (define xs (build-vector n values))
    (for ([q (in-range 0 (+ n 3))])
      (check-equal? (binary-search xs q) (linear-search xs q)))))

files.lib/check.rkt:
;; 检查表的求值规则。改这里等于改所有 check-* 的语义。
(define-syntax check-rule
  (syntax-rules ()
    [(check-true expr)      (eq? expr #t)]
    [(check-false expr)     (eq? expr #f)]
    [(check-not-false expr) expr]))

files.cases.rkt:
;; 每条断言都带一个标号，方便逐条指认。
(module+ test
  (require rackunit)
  (define v #(1 3 3 5 8))
  (check-equal?     (binary-search v 1)   0)   ;; A1
  (check-false      (binary-search v 0))       ;; A2
  (check-equal?     (binary-search v 8)   4)   ;; A3
  (check-false      (binary-search v 100))     ;; A4
  (check-false      (binary-search v 4))       ;; A5
  (check-equal?     (binary-search #(7) 7) 0)  ;; A6
  (check-false      (binary-search #() 1))     ;; A7
  (check-not-false  (memv (binary-search v 3) '(1 2))))  ;; A8
